title: Elektron vzw National Consortium Agreements — Elsevier ScienceDirect & Scopus (2023–2026)
institution: Elektron vzw (Flemish University & College Library Consortium)
notes: Elektron vzw (the Flemish university and college library consortium, hosted at KU Leuven) has two separate four-year agreements with Elsevier running 2023–2026: one for ScienceDirect (package deal covering electronic journals and e-books) and one for Scopus (bibliographic database). Confirmed via a Belgian public-procurement sole-supplier justification notice filed by Vrije Universiteit Brussel (published 26 Nov 2024), which states Elsevier is the unique/only supplier for both. No pricing or exact contract value publicly disclosed. This is a consortium-level deal, separate from any individual institution's own subscriptions already tracked in the Competitor Matrix. Web of Science / other Clarivate products not covered by this specific notice.
source: Belgian public procurement notice (VUB sole-supplier justification, 26 Nov 2024, via IT Tenders aggregator)
